description:
Align is a personal planner for tasks, notes, projects, goals, habits and a simple money log. Connect it to ChatGPT to work with your own plan in conversation: ask what is due today or overdue, find a note, check progress on a goal, or see this month's income and spending. When you ask, ChatGPT can add a task, change a task's date or status, mark it done, write a note, or update a project.

You choose what to share on Align's consent screen. Align's tools cannot delete anything, cannot open the encrypted Vault, cannot read health data, and cannot move money — Align only records numbers you enter. You can disconnect at any time from ChatGPT or from Align (Settings → AI Service).

defaultPrompt: What's on my list for today, and what's overdue?
Add a task to send the invoice on Friday, high priority.
How am I doing on my goals this quarter?
